device_path.description: Input event device path for the HDAPS sensor (e.g., /dev/input/event0, /dev/input/mouse0).

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity threshold (0–100). Higher values make the daemon respond to smaller movements.

enabled.description: Whether the HDAPS protection is active.

hysteresis.description: Delay (ms) before reactivating protection after movement stops — prevents rapid toggling.

loglevel.description: Verbosity: 0 (none) to 4 (debug). Recommended: 2 for warnings/errors, 3 for normal operation.

protect_cmd.description: Command executed when movement is detected (e.g., parking disk heads). Can include arguments.

relax_cmd.description: Command executed when the device is deemed stable again (e.g., unhalt disk activity).

sample_interval.description: Time (ms) between sensor readings. Shorter = more responsive but higher CPU load.

min_move.description: Minimum raw acceleration change required to consider movement (unitless sensor scale).

raise_count.description: Number of consecutive high readings needed before triggering protection.

fall_count.description: Number of consecutive low readings needed before releasing protection.

items.description: Axis name(s) to monitor for motion.

axes.description: List of axes to monitor. Usually 'x' and 'y' (laptop plane), 'z' (vertical) may be unreliable.
